mapper.select: SELECT tm.item_id FROM timeline_messages tm JOIN messages m ON m.message_id=tm.item_id AND m.thread_id=tm.thread_id AND m.turn_id=tm.turn_id JOIN turns t ON t.turn_id=tm.turn_id AND t.thread_id=tm.thread_id AND t.current_path=1 WHERE tm.thread_id=#{threadId} AND tm.message_kind='USER_INPUT' AND m.role='USER' ORDER BY m.ordinal DESC LIMIT 1

WITH chain AS ( SELECT turn_id,turn_sequence,current_path,source_message_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY turn_sequence) AS slot, COUNT(*) OVER() AS turn_count FROM turns WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} ), user_shape AS ( SELECT c.turn_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.thread_id=#{threadId} AND m.turn_id=c.turn_id AND m.role='USER') AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timeline_messages tm JOIN messages m ON m.message_id=tm.item_id AND m.thread_id=tm.thread_id AND m.turn_id=tm.turn_id WHERE tm.thread_id=#{threadId} AND tm.turn_id=c.turn_id AND tm.message_kind='USER_INPUT' AND m.role='USER') AS timeline_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timeline_messages tm JOIN messages m ON m.message_id=tm.item_id AND m.thread_id=tm.thread_id AND m.turn_id=tm.turn_id WHERE tm.thread_id=#{threadId} AND tm.turn_id=c.turn_id AND tm.message_kind='USER_INPUT' AND m.role='USER' AND json_array_length(m.blocks_json)=1 AND json_type(m.blocks_json,'$[0].kind')='text' AND json_extract(m.blocks_json,'$[0].kind')='text' AND json_type(m.blocks_json,'$[0].text')='text' AND instr(json_extract(m.blocks_json,'$[0].text'),'继续')>0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(m.blocks_json,'$[0]'))=2 AND instr(tm.public_text,'继续')>0) AS continue_like_count FROM chain c ) SELECT ( SELECT COALESCE((SELECT m.message_id FROM messages m WHERE m.thread_id=#{threadId} AND m.turn_id=root.turn_id AND m.role='USER' ORDER BY m.ordinal LIMIT 1), '') FROM chain root WHERE root.slot=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chain)=4 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chain WHERE current_path=1 AND source_message_id IS NULL)=4 AND (SELECT user_count FROM user_shape WHERE turn_id=root.turn_id)>0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chain tail JOIN user_shape shape ON shape.turn_id=tail.turn_id WHERE tail.slot BETWEEN 2 AND 4 AND shape.continue_like_count<1 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chain latest JOIN messages candidate ON candidate.thread_id=#{threadId} AND candidate.turn_id=latest.turn_id JOIN timeline_messages candidate_item ON candidate_item.item_id=candidate.message_id AND candidate_item.thread_id=candidate.thread_id AND candidate_item.turn_id=candidate.turn_id WHERE latest.slot=4 AND candidate.message_id=#{candidateMessageId} AND candidate.role='USER' AND candidate_item.message_kind='USER_INPUT' ) LIMIT 1 )
mapper.sql: chain AS ( SELECT turn_id,turn_sequence,state,current_path,source_message_id,parent_turn_id,root_turn_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY turn_sequence) AS slot, COUNT(*) OVER() AS turn_count FROM turns WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} ), user_shape AS ( SELECT c.turn_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.thread_id=#{threadId} AND m.turn_id=c.turn_id AND m.role='USER') AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timeline_messages tm JOIN messages m ON m.message_id=tm.item_id AND m.thread_id=tm.thread_id AND m.turn_id=tm.turn_id WHERE tm.thread_id=#{threadId} AND tm.turn_id=c.turn_id AND tm.message_kind='USER_INPUT' AND m.role='USER') AS timeline_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timeline_messages tm JOIN messages m ON m.message_id=tm.item_id AND m.thread_id=tm.thread_id AND m.turn_id=tm.turn_id WHERE tm.thread_id=#{threadId} AND tm.turn_id=c.turn_id AND tm.message_kind='USER_INPUT' AND m.role='USER' AND json_array_length(m.blocks_json)=1 AND json_type(m.blocks_json,'$[0].kind')='text' AND json_extract(m.blocks_json,'$[0].kind')='text' AND json_type(m.blocks_json,'$[0].text')='text' AND json_extract(m.blocks_json,'$[0].text')='继续' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(m.blocks_json,'$[0]'))=2 AND tm.public_text='继续') AS exact_continue_count FROM chain c ), gate AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chain)=4 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chain WHERE current_path=1 AND source_message_id IS NULL AND parent_turn_id IS NULL AND root_turn_id IS NULL)=4 AND (SELECT state FROM chain WHERE slot=1)='FAILED' AND (SELECT state FROM chain WHERE slot=2)='FAILED' AND (SELECT state FROM chain WHERE slot=3)='CANCELLED' AND (SELECT state FROM chain WHERE slot=4)='FAILED' AND (SELECT user_count FROM user_shape WHERE turn_id=(SELECT turn_id FROM chain WHERE slot=1))=1 AND (SELECT timeline_user_count FROM user_shape WHERE turn_id=(SELECT turn_id FROM chain WHERE slot=1))=1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM messages source JOIN chain root ON root.turn_id=source.turn_id WHERE root.slot=1 AND source.thread_id=#{threadId} AND source.message_id=#{sourceMessageId} AND source.role='USER' AND json_array_length(source.blocks_json)=1 AND json_type(source.blocks_json,'$[0].kind')='text' AND json_extract(source.blocks_json,'$[0].kind')='text' AND json_type(source.blocks_json,'$[0].text')='text' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM json_each(source.blocks_json,'$[0]'))=2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM timeline_messages source_item WHERE source_item.item_id=source.message_id AND source_item.thread_id=source.thread_id AND source_item.turn_id=source.turn_id AND source_item.message_kind='USER_INPUT') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chain tail JOIN user_shape shape ON shape.turn_id=tail.turn_id WHERE tail.slot BETWEEN 2 AND 4 AND (shape.user_count!=1 OR shape.timeline_user_count!=1 OR shape.exact_continue_count!=1) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chain latest JOIN messages candidate ON candidate.thread_id=#{threadId} AND candidate.turn_id=latest.turn_id JOIN timeline_messages candidate_item ON candidate_item.item_id=candidate.message_id AND candidate_item.thread_id=candidate.thread_id AND candidate_item.turn_id=candidate.turn_id WHERE latest.slot=4 AND candidate.message_id=#{candidateMessageId} AND candidate.role='USER' AND candidate_item.message_kind='USER_INPUT' ) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tools tool WHERE tool.thread_id=#{threadId} AND tool.turn_id=(SELECT turn_id FROM chain WHERE slot=1))=3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tools tool JOIN chain owner ON owner.turn_id=tool.turn_id WHERE tool.thread_id=#{threadId} AND owner.slot=1 AND (tool.side_effect!='READ_ONLY' OR tool.state!='SUCCEEDED')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tools tool JOIN chain owner ON owner.turn_id=tool.turn_id WHERE tool.thread_id=#{threadId} AND owner.slot BETWEEN 2 AND 4) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM approvals approval JOIN chain owner ON owner.turn_id=approval.turn_id WHERE approval.thread_id=#{threadId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages message JOIN chain owner ON owner.turn_id=message.turn_id JOIN message_attachments attachment ON attachment.message_id=message.message_id WHERE message.thread_id=#{threadId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pending_inputs input JOIN chain owner ON owner.turn_id=input.turn_id WHERE input.thread_id=#{threadId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM turn_internal_context context JOIN chain owner ON owner.turn_id=context.turn_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM turn_execution execution JOIN chain owner ON owner.turn_id=execution.turn_id WHERE COALESCE(json_extract(execution.state_json,'$.common.origin'),'')!='USER') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_context_seeds seed JOIN chain owner ON owner.turn_id=seed.parent_turn_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS matches )
mapper.select: WITH SELECT matches FROM gate
mapper.update: WITH UPDATE turns SET current_path=0,source_message_id=#{sourceMessageId} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND current_path=1 AND turn_id IN (SELECT turn_id FROM chain WHERE slot BETWEEN 2 AND 4) AND (SELECT matches FROM gate)=1
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM messages source JOIN timeline_messages source_item ON source_item.item_id=source.message_id AND source_item.thread_id=source.thread_id AND source_item.turn_id=source.turn_id AND source_item.message_kind='USER_INPUT' JOIN turns owner ON owner.turn_id=source.turn_id AND owner.thread_id=source.thread_id AND owner.current_path=1 WHERE source.thread_id=#{threadId} AND source.message_id=#{sourceMessageId} AND source.role='USER' AND source.message_id=( SELECT latest.item_id FROM timeline_messages latest JOIN messages latest_message ON latest_message.message_id=latest.item_id AND latest_message.thread_id=latest.thread_id AND latest_message.turn_id=latest.turn_id JOIN turns latest_turn ON latest_turn.turn_id=latest.turn_id AND latest_turn.thread_id=latest.thread_id AND latest_turn.current_path=1 WHERE latest.thread_id=#{threadId} AND latest.message_kind='USER_INPUT' AND latest_message.role='USER' ORDER BY latest_message.ordinal DESC LIMIT 1) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM timeline_messages earlier JOIN messages earlier_message ON earlier_message.message_id=earlier.item_id WHERE earlier.thread_id=source.thread_id AND earlier.turn_id=owner.turn_id AND earlier.message_kind='USER_INPUT' AND earlier_message.role='USER' AND earlier_message.ordinal<source.ordinal) AND (SELECT latest_attempt.state FROM turns latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.thread_id=source.thread_id AND latest_attempt.current_path=1 AND (latest_attempt.turn_id=owner.turn_id OR latest_attempt.source_message_id=source.message_id) ORDER BY latest_attempt.turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turns successful WHERE successful.thread_id=source.thread_id AND successful.current_path=1 AND successful.state='COMPLETED' AND (successful.turn_id=owner.turn_id OR successful.source_message_id=source.message_id)) )
mapper.update: UPDATE turns SET current_path=0 WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND current_path=1 AND turn_sequence>=( SELECT owner.turn_sequence FROM messages source JOIN turns owner ON owner.turn_id=source.turn_id AND owner.thread_id=source.thread_id WHERE source.thread_id=#{threadId} AND source.message_id=#{sourceMessageId})

UPDATE threads SET last_seen_turn_sequence=( SELECT turn_sequence FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1), revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{occurredAt} WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (SELECT state FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id AND current_path=1 ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') AND COALESCE(last_seen_turn_sequence,0)<( SELECT turn_sequence FROM turns WHERE turns.thread_id=threads.thread_id ORDER BY turn_sequence DESC LIMIT 1)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM turns WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL','SUSPENDED')
mapper.sql: WITH items AS ( SELECT tm.item_id,'message' AS item_kind,tm.created_at,tm.turn_id,NULL AS call_id,NULL AS tool_name, NULL AS tool_ordinal,NULL AS tool_state,tm.message_kind, CASE WHEN tm.message_kind='REASONING_SUMMARY' THEN substr(tm.public_text,1,65536) ELSE tm.public_text END AS public_text,m.blocks_json,tm.model_round, NULL AS presentation_json, NULL AS approval_id,NULL AS decision,NULL AS expires_at, CASE WHEN tm.message_kind='USER_INPUT' THEN COALESCE(( SELECT json_group_array(json_object( 'attachmentId',ordered.attachment_id,'displayName',ordered.display_name, 'sizeBytes',ordered.size_bytes,'mediaKind',lower(ordered.media_kind), 'mediaType',ordered.media_type)) FROM (SELECT ma.attachment_id,a.display_name,a.size_bytes,a.media_kind,a.media_type FROM message_attachments ma JOIN attachments a ON a.attachment_id=ma.attachment_id WHERE ma.message_id=tm.item_id ORDER BY ma.ordinal) ordered ),json_array()) ELSE NULL END AS attachments_json, tm.source_thread_id,tm.source_title FROM timeline_messages tm JOIN turns path_turn ON path_turn.turn_id=tm.turn_id AND path_turn.thread_id=tm.thread_id AND path_turn.current_path=1 LEFT JOIN messages m ON m.message_id=tm.item_id WHERE tm.thread_id=#{threadId} AND tm.item_id NOT GLOB 'item_partial_*' AND NOT (tm.message_kind='FINAL_ANSWER' AND path_turn.state='FAILED') UNION ALL SELECT call_id||'_call','tool_call',created_at,turn_id,call_id,tool_name,ordinal,state, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,presentation_json,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM tools WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turns path_turn WHERE path_turn.turn_id=tools.turn_id AND path_turn.thread_id=tools.thread_id AND path_turn.current_path=1) UNION ALL SELECT a.approval_id,'approval',a.requested_at,a.turn_id,a.call_id,t.tool_name,NULL,NULL, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,a.approval_id,a.decision,a.expires_at,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM approvals a JOIN tools t ON t.turn_id=a.turn_id AND t.call_id=a.call_id WHERE a.thread_id=#{threadId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM turns path_turn WHERE path_turn.turn_id=a.turn_id AND path_turn.thread_id=a.thread_id AND path_turn.current_path=1) ), ordered_items AS ( SELECT items.*, CASE WHEN message_kind='USER_INPUT' THEN 0 WHEN message_kind='REASONING_SUMMARY' THEN 1 WHEN message_kind='ASSISTANT_PROGRESS' THEN 2 WHEN item_kind='tool_call' THEN 3 WHEN item_kind='approval' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS semantic_order, COALESCE(tool_ordinal,-1) AS ordinal_order FROM items )
mapper.select: WITH latest_attempt AS ( SELECT source_message_id,MAX(turn_sequence) AS latest_sequence FROM turns WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND current_path=1 AND source_message_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_message_id ) SELECT owner.turn_id FROM latest_attempt attempt JOIN messages source ON source.message_id=attempt.source_message_id AND source.thread_id=#{threadId} AND source.role='USER' JOIN turns owner ON owner.turn_id=source.turn_id AND owner.thread_id=source.thread_id UNION SELECT previous.turn_id FROM latest_attempt attempt JOIN turns previous ON previous.thread_id=#{threadId} AND previous.current_path=1 AND previous.source_message_id=attempt.source_message_id AND previous.turn_sequence<attempt.latest_sequence

SELECT u.turn_id,u.request_id,u.model_round,u.request_ordinal,u.purpose,u.certainty, u.profile_json,u.input_tokens,u.output_tokens,u.total_tokens,u.cache_read_tokens,u.cache_write_tokens, u.new_input_tokens,u.input_accounting,u.created_at AS occurred_at FROM usage u JOIN turns x ON x.turn_id=u.turn_id WHERE u.thread_id=#{threadId} AND x.current_path=1 ORDER BY x.turn_sequence DESC,u.request_ordinal DESC,u.usage_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS measured_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND new_input_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS new_input_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND new_input_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN new_input_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS new_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND output_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS output_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND output_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN output_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND total_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND total_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN total_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_read_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN cache_read_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_read_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_write_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN cache_write_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_write_tokens,
COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND new_input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL AND (cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL OR input_accounting='INPUT_INCLUDES_CACHE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_complete_request_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND new_input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL AND (cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL OR input_accounting='INPUT_INCLUDES_CACHE') THEN new_input_tokens + cache_read_tokens + COALESCE(cache_write_tokens, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_complete_input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN certainty='KNOWN' AND new_input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL AND (cache_write_tokens IS NOT NULL OR input_accounting='INPUT_INCLUDES_CACHE') THEN cache_read_tokens ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cache_complete_read_tokens FROM usage WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND purpose IN ('ASSISTANT','SUMMARY')

SELECT a.artifact_id,a.sha256,a.content,a.byte_length FROM change_set_artifacts a JOIN threads t ON t.thread_id=a.thread_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN turns x ON x.turn_id=a.turn_id AND x.thread_id=a.thread_id WHERE a.thread_id=#{threadId} AND a.turn_id=#{turnId} AND a.artifact_id=#{artifactId} AND x.state IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')
